card.name: Words just before "currency"
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected "currency" or money term, such as "foreign", "English", "British" or "'s" after country. It also fires on nearby words in sentences about money.

modes.label: Modifier before currency
modes.description: An adjective or nationality word that is followed by "currency" or "exchange".
modes.example: The pressing need to earn<< foreign>> currency and the rising price of good quality

modes.label: Possessive or phrase leading to currency
modes.description: A small word in a phrase that ends in "currency", including figurative uses.
modes.example: it is by Deng's order that Mao still looks out over Tiananmen Square and his face still appears<< on>> the country's currency.

modes.label: Money-system context
modes.description: A word inside a phrase about monetary systems or crypto where money terms come next.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word "currency" (and its forms in other languages) next.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to say "currency", as in "foreign" before "currency".
